bear_assumptions: Iron ore falls toward a stressed part of the cycle, Chinese steel demand weakens, unit costs rise, and remediation and growth spending absorb cash while net debt remains elevated.
base_assumptions: Iron ore normalizes below the recent realized price, operational gains and base-metals growth offset part of the price decline, and recurring free cash flow supports distributions without increasing leverage.
bull_assumptions: Iron ore remains resilient, S11D and other assets deliver volume and cost gains, copper projects advance, and stronger cash conversion reduces net debt while liabilities remain controlled.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if normalized base and expected returns, bear/base payoff, margin of safety and an accepted relationship clear the canonical gates; downgrade if iron-ore demand or prices weaken without cost offsets, production reliability reverses, projects or remediation liabilities overrun, or net debt rises.
